newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia plans flat phone rate in multimedia zone.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia plans flat phone rate in multimedia zone.

text.p: Malaysia plans to charge a "flat rate" for telecommunication services in its proposed high technology zone, the Multimedia Super Corridoor (MSC), said the Minister of Energy, Telecommunications and Posts Leo Moggie.

"The tariff structure for the MSC will be based on a flat rate, on competitive principle " he told reporters after launching celebrations marking the 10th year of privatised telephone services in Malaysia.
He did not elaborate on what the flat rate would mean to users.

By doing so, the corridor, through which Malaysia plans to attract world-class information-technology companies to invest in the country, will be "very attractive for investors," said Moggie in his speech.
The brainchild of Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad, MSC is a 15 km by 50 km zone stretching south from Kuala Lumpur to where a new airport and federal capital are being built.
The traditional tariff structure for international calls within Malaysia was not suitable for the MSC, said Moggie.
